title: The List of Fate
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when Su Qingyao's bloodline power awakened, a vast phantom abruptly condensed above the Imperial Capital—that was the echo of the Fate Scribe from ten thousand years ago, and its appearance announced the existence of the Fourth Possibility.

text.content: The betrayer's laughter gradually faded, blood winding into eerie patterns on the blue stone floor of the interrogation chamber. Chen Ji stood in the shadows, his expression coldly indifferent as usual, as if everything before him was merely a chess game that had already ended. Yet his fingertips trembled slightly within his sleeves—not from fear, but because moments ago, the Tianji Record had transmitted an unusual vibration.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, this person... the way he looked at you before dying, something was off.

text.content: Su Qingyao entered the interrogation chamber, her brow slightly furrowed. She had been organizing clues outside all along, and now stepping into this blood-soaked place, she felt a strange sense of familiarity rising from the depths of her bloodline. She unconsciously covered her chest—where a heart that had been different since childhood beat, a heart capable of sensing danger.

dialogue.content: Senior Su's eyes are as sharp as ever. Rest assured, a dead person cannot cause any trouble.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped aside, his gaze casually sweeping across Su Qingyao's face. In the flickering lamplight, a faint golden pattern faintly appeared at her brow center, vanishing in an instant. This detail, caught by Chen Ji's eyes, struck like thunder. The Tianji Record Fragment shook frantically in her Mental Sea, and countless blurry fragmentary images surged forth—records about the Fate Scribe, fragments of that catastrophe from ten thousand years ago.

Su Qingyao squatted down, staring at the betrayer's contorted features. His lips still carried that eerie smile, as if he had seen something extremely amusing before dying. She reached out, her fingertips touching the blood residue on his brow center—the next instant, an icy current of electricity coursed into her meridians.

Su Qingyao jerked backward, her pupils contracting sharply. The spiritual power fragments remaining in that blood stain had actually resonated with the power dormant in her body for years! That was a power she had never awakened, now like an awakened ancient giant slowly opening its eyes.

Chen Ji's voice came from behind, carrying appropriately measured concern. Yet his gaze was firmly locked on the faintly visible golden pattern at Su Qingyao's brow center, his heart churning like violent waves. The information from the Tianji Record told him an unbelievable truth—Su Qingyao's bloodline was of the same lineage as the Fate Scribe from ten thousand years ago.

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment flew out of Chen Ji's body uncontrollably, hovering in mid-air within the interrogation chamber. The yellowed pages rustled and turned, finally stopping on a page of golden text that had never appeared before. The text was ancient and majestic, as if carrying the imprint of Heavenly Dao's will.

Su Qingyao looked up, instantly struck like by lightning. At the very top of the list were four characters—'Fate Writing,' and below was a dense list of names. But at the seventh position, a name made her whole body stiffen: Su Qingyao. Ten thousand years ago, she had already been on this list.

dialogue.content: Impossible... how could I... how could someone from ten thousand years ago have any connection to me!

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze swept across other familiar names on the list—some were enemies he already knew, others were powerful figures he had never met. When he saw a notation at the end of the list, his pupils contracted sharply: 'This bloodline must wait until the timing matures before awakening. The day of awakening is when the Fourth Possibility opens.'

dialogue.content: The Fourth Possibility... so that's how it is. Fate has never been simply black or white.

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden truth, Su Qingyao's bloodline began to stir restlessly. She felt the power dormant for ten thousand years within her awakening, yet she didn't know whether to accept or resist. Chen Ji stood quietly在一旁, waiting for her choice.

choices.description: Su Qingyao decided to stop running. She would actively activate her bloodline power and face the approaching fate countdown together with Chen Ji.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Partial Power of the Fate Scribe
choices.risk_hint: The awakening process is irreversible and will attract the attention of the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath, slowly closing her eyes. Her hands formed an ancient mudra, and the golden pattern at her brow center began to spread, like burning flames clinging to her skin. Agonizing pain struck, she clenched her teeth but made no sound.

Chen Ji stepped forward, grasping her trembling hand. Warm power flowed from his palm, forming a subtle balance with the狂暴的 bloodline power within her. At that moment, the threads of fate between the two seemed to intertwine, never to be separated again.

choices.description: Su Qingyao tried to suppress the power within her. She did not believe in any fate from ten thousand years ago; she only wanted to control her own destiny with her own will.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain current strength, temporarily avoid Heavenly Dao's attention
choices.risk_hint: Forcible suppression may cause bloodline rebound, and miss the opportunity to resonate with Chen Ji

text.content: Su Qingyao's eyes snapped open, forcibly cutting off her resonance with that power. The golden pattern at her brow center receded like the tide, but her body trembled violently, and a mouthful of blood spewed forth.

dialogue.content: I don't believe in fate! My fate, Su Qingyao's fate, will only be written by myself!

choices.description: Su Qingyao confessed her confusion and fear to Chen Ji, inviting him to find a third path together—neither blindly following fate nor forcibly resisting.
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the bond with Chen Ji, unlock prerequisites for Shared Destiny state
choices.risk_hint: Requires extremely high trust foundation, and the process is full of unknowns

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I don't know what to do. But I know... you and I, perhaps from the very beginning, have been bound together.

text.content: Her voice trembled slightly, her eyes red-rimmed yet stubbornly refusing to let tears fall. This was the first time Su Qingyao had shown such a vulnerable side before Chen Ji. Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly spoke.

Chen Ji sighed softly, reaching up to wipe away the blood at the corner of Su Qingyao's lips. His action was unexpectedly gentle, completely different from his usual cold and calculating persona as the废物 disciple.

dialogue.content: Fate indeed exists. But it was never meant to be submitted to—it was meant to be broken.

text.content: His voice was low and powerful, as if stating an ancient truth. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated above the two of them, golden light enveloping their figures. That light contained some ancient power, attempting to forcibly weave together two strands of fate that should never have intertwined.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's light grew brighter and brighter. Su Qingyao felt unprecedented power pouring into her body. At the same time, she sensed the Tianji Record's operation within Chen Ji—a strange resonance, as if their fates could truly merge into one.

choices.description: Su Qingyao actively opened her meridians, welcoming that resonance power. She was willing to share the weight of Heavenly Fate with Chen Ji, even if the path ahead was a bottomless abyss.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock 'Shared Destiny' buff, Heavenly Fate consumption shared by two
choices.risk_hint: Once bound, any loss Chen Ji suffers will affect Su Qingyao

text.content: Su Qingyao reached out, her fingertips touching the edge of the Tianji Record. In that instant, golden light exploded, enveloping the entire interrogation chamber. Their consciousness briefly merged—she saw Chen Ji's schemes, calculations, forbearance over the years, and... that childlike heart he had never shown anyone.

dialogue.content: So you have always... been carrying all this alone.

choices.description: Although Su Qingyao was moved, she still wanted to maintain some distance. She chose to trust Chen Ji but was unwilling to so quickly surrender her fate completely.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot immediately obtain Shared Destiny buff
choices.visible_reward: Preserve space for independent judgment, avoid blind binding
choices.risk_hint: Missing the optimal resonance timing may affect subsequent bond deepening

text.content: Su Qingyao withdrew her hand, stepping back half a pace. Her gaze was complex as she looked at Chen Ji, softly saying: 'Give me some time. I need... to confirm some things.'

dialogue.content: Take your time. Fate is not something to rush.

text.content: Outside the interrogation chamber, the night wind suddenly rose. The dark clouds above the Imperial Capital gathered thicker and thicker, as if some invisible existence was watching all this. Chen Ji looked up at the window, a trace of solemnity passing through his brow—the warning from the Tianji Record told him a greater storm was approaching.

dialogue.content: Whatever choice you make, I will respect it. But there is one thing I must tell you—the connection between you and me may be even deeper than what this list reveals. Ten thousand years ago, you were the guardian chosen by the Tianji Record, and I... am the continuation of that choice.

text.content: Su Qingyao stared at him blankly. Moonlight filtered through the window lattice, drawing a hazy band of light between the two. Countless questions churned in her heart—what was the truth from ten thousand years ago? How many more secrets was Chen Ji hiding? And what role would she play in this chess game of heaven and earth?

At this moment, a vast phantom abruptly condensed above the Imperial Capital. The phantom was immense, its features blurred, yet radiating an oppressive might that stole one's breath. The phantom slowly opened its eyes, overlooking the entire Imperial Capital, its voice like thunder echoing in every person's ears: 'The Fourth Possibility... has begun.'
